name: PostgreSQL pgvector Ingestion and HNSW Indexing
prompt: Implement the /api/v1/documents/ingest endpoint using LlamaIndex and PostgreSQL pgvector. Split the document into overlapping chunks, generate 384-dimensional dense vectors, and store them into the data_rag_embeddings table with JSONB metadata.

verification.criteria: Ingestion returns HTTP 201 with status 'indexed' and nodes_created >= 1
